notes: Read all 84 source lines with line numbers before porting. Covered: the react/framer-motion/cn/lucide-react imports (L1-4), the AccordionProps interface incl. title/children/defaultOpen, the controlled open/onOpenChange contract with its doc comment, icon/badge/headerExtra, and the headerClassName/bodyClassName/className override props (L6-27), the component doc comment (L29), the destructured signature (L30-42), the controlled-vs-uncontrolled open resolution and setOpen (L43-49), the container+header button render (L50-66), and the AnimatePresence/motion.div body reveal (L67-84).

Preserved behavior 1:1: isControlled is true only when BOTH open and onOpenChange are provided (L43); internalOpen is seeded from defaultOpen (L44); open resolves to openProp when controlled else internalOpen (L45); setOpen calls onOpenChange when controlled else setInternalOpen (L46-49); the header toggles via onPress={() => setOpen(!open)} (L54). Prop names title/children/defaultOpen/open/onOpenChange/icon/badge/headerExtra are kept verbatim.

Converted framer-motion <AnimatePresence>+<motion.div initial/animate/exit height 0->auto, opacity 0->1, transition 0.2s> (L67-81) to a single Animated progress value (0 collapsed -> 1 expanded) driving a measured-height clip (onLayout, since RN has no height:'auto') plus opacity over a 200ms Easing.inOut curve; AnimatePresence's exit-then-unmount is reproduced via a `rendered` flag kept true while open OR while the close animation finishes. The lucide <ChevronDown className='rotate-180 when open, transition-transform'> (L65) became an Animated.Text '\u25BE' glyph rotating 0deg->180deg from the same progress value.

Replaced DOM <div> container (L51) and <button aria-expanded> header (L52-60) with View + Pressable carrying accessibilityRole='button' and accessibilityState={{expanded}} (mirroring aria-expanded). The icon slot, flex-1 title (text-sm/font-medium 500/--text-primary), badge and headerExtra (L61-64) map to a View icon wrapper, an AppText title styled fontSize 14/fontWeight 500/colors.textPrimary, and the badge/headerExtra nodes rendered as-is. cn() Tailwind classes and CSS-var tokens became StyleSheet styles + theme tokens; white/[0.06] container border, white/[0.04] body top border, white/[0.02] hover->pressed bg, and --text-muted chevron/icon are preserved as literal rgba/colors.textMuted.

DOM-only className/headerClassName/bodyClassName override props (L23-26, L51/58/76) have no native analog; they are replaced by style/headerStyle/bodyStyle (StyleProp<ViewStyle>) that preserve the source's 'use the override else fall back to the default px-4 py-3 padding' semantics via conditional style composition. Added a native-only optional testID for composition. No DOM modules, browser HTML elements, framer-motion, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, old web UI imports, API paths, or unit conversions were introduced.
